description: Every Liongard endpoint, plus an offline copy of your whole MSP estate you can join, search, and drift-check from one command.

novel_features.name: Cross-estate drift window
novel_features.description: Every change detected across all your client environments within a time window, joined to the owning environment and system.

novel_features.name: Environment 360
novel_features.description: One client's complete picture in a single command: its systems, each system's launchpoints, agent, latest inspection, open detections, and key metrics.

novel_features.name: Stale launchpoints sweep
novel_features.description: Every launchpoint whose newest inspection is older than a threshold, with the owning environment and system named.

novel_features.name: Agent-offline sweep
novel_features.description: Every offline agent across the estate, joined to the environment it serves.

novel_features.name: Coverage reconcile
novel_features.description: Monitoring gaps: systems with no launchpoint bound, and environments with no systems at all.

novel_features.name: Metric pivot
novel_features.description: One RoarPath metric pulled across every system as a system-by-value table, CSV-ready for reports.

novel_features.name: Metric threshold scan
novel_features.description: Every system whose RoarPath metric value crosses a numeric threshold.

novel_features.name: Bulk inspection kick
novel_features.description: Find stale launchpoints and trigger an inspection run on each, in one guarded command.

novel_features.name: System change history
novel_features.description: The full chronological change history of one system: every detection and inspection entry in time order.

novel_features.name: Inspection-failure sweep
novel_features.description: Every inspection that ran but failed or errored across the estate, joined to the owning environment.

novel_features.name: Inspector adoption gap
novel_features.description: Which environments are missing a given inspector type - the estate-wide rollout-gap view.

novel_features.name: Estate health rollup
novel_features.description: One estate-wide health scorecard: stale launchpoints, offline agents, failed inspections, and coverage gaps as a single summary with a typed exit code.
